conf.description: AWS GovCloud VPC Flow Logs flow / api-pull: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: aws-vpcflow / flow / api-pull. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (AWS integration, vpcflow data stream). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
